scope: Read-only narrow follow-up of corrected archive settlement, independent wrapper, finite archive placement and setup pin templating. No tests, operations, Docker, process census or archive/tree hash executed.

priorFindings.details: 900s wait is independent of inner Monitor thread. Failed/timeout path attempts settlement of exact saved leader and client PID/start identities with at most two 10s waits each. OS I/O/scheduling is explicitly not preemptively bounded; no daemon drain or descendant census.
Unexpected signal/wait errors become settlementErrorType/leaderSettlementUnknown in stop_owned; they no longer replace the initial archive export exception at those reviewed calls.

receiptClarifications.finding: Z/X state currently raises ProcessLookupError and is converted to leaderAbsent=true. That establishes non-live identity, not absence of the PID.
receiptClarifications.requested: Explicit exited-or-zombie/non-live state or separate missing-versus-non-live classification; do not claim zero PIDs.

receiptClarifications.finding: If obtaining leader start ticks immediately after Popen fails, failed=true prevents success but the leader settlement list can be empty.
receiptClarifications.requested: Make missing leader identity/settlement uncertainty explicit, without signaling an unverified/reused process.

confirmed: Hard compressed/raw caps still refuse and retain partial bytes before setup publication.
Wrapper source pins include archive source, budget and startup template. Inner source also pins legacy primitives, runtime helper, original candidate and saved setup/draft inputs.
Required archive and saved pins change only after verified archive and before/after source/evidence guards; no automatic retry or rollback is added.
425-to-root requires exact known TMP file and both old aliases, verified copy before replacing either alias, verified new hardlink pair before retiring TMP original into a compatibility link.
425-to-TMP and333-to-TMP require exact owned0600 size/hash/nlink2 pair and verify TMP copy before replacing either old hardlink with a link.

333 mode additionally requires exact root-selected publication receipt hash with published status/760 candidate/archive verification plus equality of current required archive/new setup pins. The current required760 archive remains protected by metadata across historical placement.
Finite placement modes have no Docker mutation, fixture access, broad delete or operation replay; original receipts remain hash-checked and all partial stages remain on failure.
Cohesive startup template preserves separate product/package/runtime identities and explicit Windows/performance/provider/export limits; it does not claim completed full acceptance.
limits: No actual archive export/publication/placement or control outcomes independently executed here.
The placement helper180s budget is cooperative between read/copy operations, not OS-I/O preemption.
Control claims require the parent final logs and frozen source binding; this review did not re-audit controls or the full startup/install behavior.
Historical archives in TMP are byte-preserved compatibility evidence, not guaranteed snapshot retention.
Opaque record/source pins and root exclusive-window coordination do not independently establish whole-machine inactivity or a future no-launch guarantee.
